author: Lütken, 1856

note.en: A reddish brittle star of reef rubble, known here from museum records. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura rojiza del escombro de arrecife, conocida aquí por registros de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 10 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 10 records in the region (many are museum specimens).

marks.en: Smooth, leathery brittle star, reddish with short spines; hides under stones and rubble.
marks.es: Ofiura lisa y coriácea, rojiza, con espinas cortas; se esconde bajo piedras y cascajo.
